# Operations: Solids and materials

Run with `./ise commit <operation> '<json parameters>'`, the MCP tool `ise_commit`, or `./ise run steps.json` for several at once (one undo step). 10 operations.

### `solid.box.create`

creates a box part, optionally with a material.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `depth` | Length | yes | Wire form of the quantity. |
| `height` | Length | yes | Wire form of the quantity. |
| `material` | StableId |  |  |
| `placement` | Placement |  |  |
| `width` | Length | yes | Wire form of the quantity. |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **Length** (Wire form of the quantity.): `unit`: LengthUnit, `value`: number
- **LengthUnit**: `"mm"`, `"cm"`, `"m"`, `"in"`, `"ft"`
- **Placement** (Position of the part origin in project coordinates (Z up).): `x`: Length, `y`: Length, `z`: Length
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `solid.box.edit`

size and placement in one atomic change (one undo step),

### `solid.material.create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cost` | MaterialCost |  | What it costs (per kg, per sheet, per bar), for BOM estimates. |
| `density` | Density | yes | Wire form of the quantity. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `properties` | EngineeringProps |  | Engineering properties (E, ν, strengths, thermal) beyond the typical ones for its name. |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **BarPrice**: `length`: number, `price`: number
- **Density** (Wire form of the quantity.): `unit`: DensityUnit, `value`: number
- **DensityUnit**: `"kg/m3"`, `"g/cm3"`
- **EngineeringProps** (A material's engineering properties as the person set them; any left out come from the simulation library's typical values for its name. Units: MPa for moduli and strengths, kg/m³ density (the material's own density is used when this has none), W/m·K, J/kg·K, 1/K, °C.): `conductivity`?: number, `e`?: number, `expansion`?: number, `fatigue_cycles`?: number, `fatigue_strength`?: number, `nu`?: number, `source`?: string, `specific_heat`?: number, `tangent_modulus`?: number, `uts`?: number, `yield_strength`?: number
- **MaterialCost** (The price of a material, in the forms it is bought: by weight, by the sheet, or by the bar. Any can be given; estimates use the form that suits the part's process (sheet for laser, router and sheet-metal parts, bar for cut extrusions, weight for everything else).): `bar`?: BarPrice, `currency`?: string, `per_kg`?: number, `sheet`?: SheetPrice
- **SheetPrice**: `length`: number, `price`: number, `thickness`?: number, `width`: number

</details>
